evals.name: choose-key
evals.prompt: Two staff can register authors. Declare the identity and command destination for an agreed registration.
evals.expected_output: A keyed state change independent of caller identity.
assertions: Defines an AuthorId concept and history owner.
Uses the command identifier as the production destination.
Keeps the staff identity out of the business fact key.

evals.name: trace-list
evals.prompt: Authors shows a Name, but registration only carries a source ID and Name. Model the read side.
evals.expected_output: A StateView with a complete key and field lineage.
assertions: Maps the row key from event source metadata.
Binds a query over the projected Name.

evals.name: unsettled-meaning
evals.prompt: The workshop disagrees whether Register author means an invitation or an immediate catalog entry. Draft the declaration?
evals.expected_output: Pause declaration at the unresolved outcome.
assertions: Does not bind the model to a guessed fact.
